research_mode: official Police.uk, ONS, Home Office, OSR and MHCLG web sources only; monthly freshness, bulk/API product separation, anonymised-location geography, GSS code history, reference-table versioning, statistical accreditation and relative-deprivation semantics; no parcel result or safety score claimed

sources.publisher: Police.uk / Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Last updated API contract
verified_claims: crime data in the API is updated once a month
the endpoint returns the latest crime-data month in ISO date format
the day component is irrelevant and exists only to preserve the date format
limitations: the returned value is dataset freshness rather than incident time
the month must be checked independently of the system clock and must not be inferred from the request date

sources.publisher: Police.uk / Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Data downloads
verified_claims: download CSVs provide street-level crime, outcome and stop-search data by force and 2021 LSOA
crime CSVs contain only the latest outcome category
a separate outcome option generates full outcome-history files
outcome data is unavailable for British Transport Police and Police Service of Northern Ireland
limitations: latest outcome and full outcome history are different products
LSOA fields describe the published anonymised geography and are not exact parcel observations

sources.publisher: Police.uk / Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: About data.police.uk data download
verified_claims: the latest complete copy is available as a CSV archive
monthly archive URLs follow a stable year-month structure
custom CSV and JSON interfaces provide subsets of the full archive
limitations: latest.zip is mutable and requires a captured month and hash before reproducible use
subset interfaces must be reconciled against requested months and forces rather than assumed complete

sources.publisher: Police.uk / Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: About data.police.uk CSV columns
verified_claims: longitude and latitude are anonymised crime coordinates
LSOA code and name refer to the LSOA containing the anonymised point
Reported by identifies the force that supplied the crime
Falls within currently also reflects the supplying force and may change
Last outcome category is the most recent associated outcome
limitations: the published LSOA is derived from an anonymised point and cannot establish the incident parcel
Reported by and Falls within must not be treated as permanently equivalent fields

sources.publisher: Police.uk / Single Online Home National Digital Team
sources.name: Locate a neighbourhood API contract
verified_claims: the method finds the neighbourhood policing team responsible for a latitude-longitude point
the response supplies a unique force identifier and a force-specific team identifier
limitations: the response is operational routing metadata rather than a statistical-geography intersection
force plus neighbourhood is required and cannot replace an ONS LSOA code

sources.name: Names, codes and lookups
verified_claims: ONS describes these products as definitive names, codes and lookups for geographies
the suite includes the Code History Database, current lookups and names-and-codes listings
the products are downloadable free of charge from the Open Geography portal
limitations: a definitive code product does not itself prove a runtime spatial intersection
the specific product edition and geography type must still be pinned

sources.name: Code History Database
verified_claims: the CHD contains live and terminated entities
geography change history is available where new codes have been allocated from 1 January 2009
the database provides relationships, hierarchies, equivalents and archived geography metadata
limitations: a terminated or predecessor code must not be silently joined to a current polygon
hierarchy or equivalence records require an explicit effective-date rule

sources.name: ONS lookup products
verified_claims: ONS maintains lookup files relating one or more geographies
the products contain nine-character GSS codes
only the latest versions are normally present on the portal while earlier versions may require separate retrieval
limitations: retrieving a latest lookup without recording its edition is not reproducible
a lookup relationship must not be assumed exact-fit unless its metadata states the allocation method

sources.name: Names and codes for OAs, LSOAs and MSOAs
verified_claims: ONS publishes names and codes files for OAs, LSOAs and MSOAs
the files contain nine-character GSS codes
the files are available through the Open Geography portal
limitations: code-format validity alone does not establish that a code belongs to the required 2021 England inventory
names are labels and must not be used as the primary join key

sources.name: Police recorded crime and outcomes open data user guide
verified_claims: police-recorded-crime figures can be substantially affected by recording policy and practice
the 2002 to 2003 introduction of the National Crime Recording Standard prevents direct before-after comparison
later improvements in recording accuracy created discontinuities for several crime types
limitations: a change in recorded counts is not automatically a change in underlying victimisation
time-series comparisons require offence-specific recording-context notes

sources.name: Police recorded crime reference-table specification
verified_claims: the release includes separate geographic and offence reference tables
the geographic table maps CSPs to force areas and regions and includes ONS codes
the offence reference table maps offence codes to descriptions and old pre-July-2013 and new post-July-2013 groups and subgroups
limitations: PFA and CSP data are not LSOA or parcel data
offence groups from different classification eras must not be combined without the reference-table version

sources.name: Police recorded crime open-data adjustment semantics
verified_claims: some pre-2019 quarterly values may be negative
forces previously deducted transferred or cancelled records from cumulative monthly returns
the design aimed to preserve accuracy at financial-year level
limitations: a negative quarterly value is an administrative adjustment and not negative crime incidence
quarterly aggregation must preserve the adjustment rather than clipping it to zero

sources.name: Quality of police recorded crime statistics review
verified_claims: police recorded crime statistics are official statistics but not accredited official statistics
accreditation was removed in 2014 after concerns about reliability and consistency
the review examines the process from force recording through assurance and final statistical production
limitations: official-statistics status is not a parcel-accuracy certificate
reaccreditation work does not imply that every offence type or force has uniform quality

sources.name: Police recorded crime accuracy findings
verified_claims: HMICFRS estimated national recording accuracy at 92.4 percent plus or minus 0.3 percentage points at the end of the 2021 to 2022 programme
17 of 23 inspected forces recorded crime with accuracy above 90 percent
force performance improved to varying extents
limitations: a national or force inspection estimate cannot be assigned to a parcel candidate
the estimate excludes fraud and belongs to a specific inspection programme

sources.name: Police recorded crime quality limitations
verified_claims: the OSR engagement included a sample of nine police forces
the report says those findings may not generalise to every force
quality is influenced by recording decisions, guidance changes, differing IT systems and the extent of quality assurance
limitations: sample findings cannot be converted to a universal force-quality multiplier
system and QA variation must remain an explicit uncertainty rather than a hidden score adjustment

sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.name: English indices of deprivation 2025 data suite
verified_claims: IoD25 is published as accredited official statistics
the release separates domains, raw scores, combined ranks-scores-deciles-denominators, underlying indicators and transformed domain scores into different files
the release applies to England
limitations: file roles are not interchangeable
the candidate's rank-derived ordinal position must not be labelled as a raw or transformed Crime Domain score

sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.name: English indices of deprivation 2025 FAQ
verified_claims: IoD25 ranks 33,755 England LSOAs
deciles divide those ranked areas into ten equal national groups
the FAQ states there is no definitive cut-off at which an area is described as deprived
limitations: rank and decile are relative ordinal measures
a percentile-like transformation is not a probability of safety or an absolute deprivation distance

sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.name: English indices of deprivation 2025 technical report
verified_claims: the technical report documents the conceptual framework and methodology for domains and the overall index
it describes design principles and quality assurance
it documents component indicators and domains
limitations: the methodology report is not runtime evidence that the candidate join completed
domain interpretation must follow the report rather than infer cardinal safety from an ordinal rank
